summary: Requested a probe of the session decision logic that protects the no-more-than-once contract. The harness registers a client session, records the fresh-series decision, stores a response for that series, re-asks without moving the client acknowledgement, then acknowledges and asks again; three CA_EVENT lines capture the (responded, update-required) pair and the stored value, which is exactly what decides whether the state machine is invoked twice for one series. Registered the investigation and cited the UpdateRequired and clearTo sources; no conclusion before the receipt.
